answer: What makes a fake identity too expensive to keep? Reputation decay. Every identity starts at 100 points. Idle for 2 epochs, it loses 8 points per epoch. Below 60, rewards and voting weight stop. Only verified work restores 6 points, capped at 100. A crystal of fresh clones looks bright for one epoch, then fades fast like a raven at dusk. How much does upkeep cost? A spiral of 1,000 clones costs 3,000 units per epoch to maintain. Skip one cycle and the whole batch drops below threshold. So what does the attacker pay? Rent forever, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
